# Budget Justification

<!-- No NIH page limit, but keep it tight and make every line traceable to a
     line in the budget form. Modular budgets (R03/R21, and R01s under
     $250K direct/year) need only Personnel; detailed budgets need all of it. -->

## Personnel

**PI Name, Degree — Role, N calendar months.** One or two sentences on what
this person does on this project specifically, tied to the Aims. Not a resume.

**TBN Postdoctoral Researcher — N calendar months.** What they will do, and
why the project needs that effort level.

## Equipment

Item, cost, and why existing institutional equipment (see Facilities) is
insufficient. Omit this section for a modular budget.

## Travel

Purpose and destination. Tie conference travel to dissemination of this
project's results.

## Other Direct Costs

- **Materials and supplies.** Per-sample or per-unit basis where possible.
- **Publication costs.** Number of expected open-access papers × typical APC.
- **Consultant services.** Name, rate, and scope.

## Consortium/Subaward Costs

Institution, PI, scope of work, and total direct + F&A. Attach the subaward's
own budget justification.
